# Hristina Georgievska

> Professional makeup artist and hair stylist based in Prague, Czech Republic, with 20+ years of international experience across fashion, editorial, beauty, advertising, and video productions.

## Overview

Hristina Georgievska is a renowned Prague-based make-up artist and hair stylist celebrated for editorial precision, clean radiant skin artistry, and creative versatility. With over two decades of professional production experience across Central Europe and internationally, she collaborates regularly with prestigious fashion publications, commercial brand campaigns, television productions, and music videos.

- **Location**: Prague, Czech Republic (Available worldwide for European and international bookings)
- **Specializations**: Fashion editorial, high-fashion beauty, advertising campaigns, music video productions, commercial shoot styling, and runway
- **Experience**: 20+ years of international industry experience
- **Editorial Credits**: Vogue, Elle, Harper's Bazaar, Marie Claire, Vanity Fair Italia, Dolcevita
- **Languages**: English, Czech, Ukrainian

## Core Portfolio Sections

- [Fashion Portfolio](https://www.hristinageorgievska.com/): High-fashion editorial collections, avant-garde makeup, and runway-inspired styling.
- [Beauty Portfolio](https://www.hristinageorgievska.com/beauty): Close-up beauty, skin-focused editorial makeup, creative colour palettes, and precision hair styling.
- [Video Productions](https://www.hristinageorgievska.com/video): Commercial campaigns, fashion films, and music videos featuring professional makeup and hair styling.
- [Contact & Bookings](https://www.hristinageorgievska.com/contact): Direct booking inquiries, representations, and contact information.

## Professional Services & Artistry

- **Editorial Makeup**: Concept creation, high-fashion styling, and publication-ready beauty for magazine covers and feature stories.
- **Commercial & Advertising**: Polished, brand-aligned beauty and grooming for advertising campaigns, brand lookbooks, and corporate shoots.
- **Hair Styling**: Editorial hair styling, texture work, sleek minimalist looks, and avant-garde runway styling.
- **On-Set Video Production**: Continuous grooming, camera-ready skin finishes, and continuity management for film, television, and digital video.

Hristina Georgievska's work has been published across major European fashion periodicals:
- Vogue Czechoslovakia & Vogue Portugal
- Elle Czech Republic
- Harper's Bazaar
- Marie Claire
- Vanity Fair Italia
- Dolcevita Magazine
